title: NCL Mine Surveyor Mock 05
pattern: 100 MCQs, 100 marks, 90 min, NO negative marking

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: The most probable value of a set of observations is their
questions.solution: Mean.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: The standard deviation measures
options: The accuracy of a single observation
The central tendency of the data
The dispersion of observations around the mean
questions.solution: Dispersion of observations around the mean.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: The variance is the
questions.solution: Square of standard deviation.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: The precision of measurements is expressed by
questions.solution: Standard deviation or variance.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: The weight of an observation is
options: Proportional to the number of observations or inversely proportional to variance
Proportional to the variance of the observation
A constant value for every instrument
Equal to the number of the observations made
questions.solution: Proportional to number or inversely to variance.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: The law of weight propagation states that
options: The weight of a computed quantity depends on weights of observations used
The weight of a sum is the product of the weights
questions.solution: Weight of computed quantity depends on input weights.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: The sum of weights of independent observations is used to determine
options: The weight of a single observation
The weight of the largest observation
questions.solution: The weight of the mean.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: The least squares method minimizes the
questions.solution: Sum of squares of residuals.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: A residual is defined as the
options: Measured value minus the most probable value
The measured value minus the true value
questions.solution: Measured value minus the most probable value.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: The condition that the sum of residuals equals zero applies to
questions.solution: Unweighted observations with equal weights.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: The error propagation law for f(x,y) is
options: The sum of the individual errors
The product of the individual errors
The average of the individual errors
sigma_f squared equals partial derivatives squared times variances
questions.solution: Partial derivatives squared times variances.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: The adjustment of a triangulation figure involves
options: Distributing misclosure according to least squares
questions.solution: Distributing misclosure by least squares.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: The mean error is defined as
options: Square root of sum of squares
Sum of absolute errors divided by number
Sum of errors divided by number
questions.solution: Sum of absolute errors divided by number.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: The probable error is approximately
questions.solution: 0.6745 times standard deviation.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: The relative error is
options: Absolute error divided by the measured value
The error per unit length only
questions.solution: Absolute error divided by measured value.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: The maximum permissible error in a survey depends on
options: The purpose and accuracy requirements of the survey
questions.solution: Purpose and accuracy requirements.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: In adjustment of observations, degrees of freedom is
options: Number of observations minus number of unknowns
The number of unknowns minus the number of observations
questions.solution: Number of observations minus number of unknowns.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: The reference standard deviation is computed from
options: Residuals divided by degrees of freedom
questions.solution: Residuals divided by degrees of freedom.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: An observation with higher weight is considered
options: Less reliable than a low-weight observation
questions.solution: More reliable.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: The chi-square test is used to
options: Test the mean of the observations
Test the variance of a sample
Test the goodness of fit of observations to a distribution
Test the median of the observations
questions.solution: Test goodness of fit to a distribution.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: The normal distribution of errors is characterized by
options: Bell-shaped curve symmetric about the mean
questions.solution: Bell-shaped curve symmetric about mean.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: The sum of positive residuals should equal the sum of negative residuals when
questions.solution: When observations have equal weights.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: The adjustment of a level network by least squares involves
options: Minimizing the sum of weighted squared corrections to observations
questions.solution: Minimizing weighted squared corrections.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: In the adjustment of triangulation, the conditions include
questions.solution: Angle condition and side condition.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: A 'condition equation' in survey adjustment expresses
options: An equation with no geometric meaning
A geometric or physical condition that must be satisfied
questions.solution: A condition that must be satisfied.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: The 'observation equation' in least squares relates
options: An observation to the unknown parameters
questions.solution: An observation to unknown parameters.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: The matrix approach to least squares uses the
options: Normal equations: (A transpose WA)x = A transpose Wl
The inverse of the residual matrix
questions.solution: Normal equations: (A'WA)x = A'Wl.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: Outliers in observations should be
options: Kept unchanged until the survey is complete
Investigated and potentially removed if gross errors
questions.solution: Investigated and potentially removed.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: The covariance between two variables measures
options: The degree to which they vary together
questions.solution: Degree to which they vary together.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: Correlation coefficient ranges from

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: The law of propagation of errors for f(x) where x has error sigma_x is
questions.solution: sigma_f = df/dx times sigma_x.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: The 'accidental error' is another name for
questions.solution: Random error.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: The trapezoidal rule for area calculation assumes
options: Boundaries between offsets are straight lines
questions.solution: Boundaries between offsets are straight lines.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: Simpsons rule for area calculation assumes
options: Boundaries between offsets are parabolic arcs
questions.solution: Boundaries are parabolic arcs.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: Simpsons rule requires
options: An odd number of offsets (even number of segments)
questions.solution: Odd number of offsets (even segments).

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: The coordinate method for area calculation uses
options: Coordinates of vertices of a closed polygon
questions.solution: Coordinates of vertices of a closed polygon.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: The planimeter is used to measure
options: The volume of a spoil dump on the plan
The distance between two traverse stations
The length of a curved line
Area of an irregular figure on a map
questions.solution: Area of an irregular figure on a map.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: A mechanical planimeter measures area by
options: Counting the number of turns of the tracing arm
Measuring the boundary with a tape
Tracing the boundary and counting wheel revolutions
questions.solution: Tracing boundary and counting wheel revolutions.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: The volume of earthwork between two sections can be calculated by
options: The average end area method only
Mean area method, prismoidal formula, or Simpson's rule
questions.solution: Mean area, prismoidal formula, or Simpson's rule.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: The prismoidal formula for volume is V = L/6(A1 + 4Am + A2) where Am is
options: The mean of A1 and A2
The area at the section of maximum depth
The area at the quarter section
questions.solution: Area at the middle section.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: The mean area method for volume is V = L x (A1+A2)/2, which is also called
questions.solution: Trapezoidal formula.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: A contour plan shows
options: Lines of equal distance from a point
Lines of equal elevation on the surface
questions.solution: Lines of equal elevation.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: The volume between two contour lines can be calculated using the
options: Trapezoidal or prismoidal formula with contour areas
questions.solution: Trapezoidal or prismoidal formula.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: The curve for haul road layout is typically a
options: A clothoid transition curve of long radius
A series of short straight segments
questions.solution: Circular curve or transition curve.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: The degree of a circular curve is defined as
options: The central angle subtended by a chord of standard length
The angle subtended by the radius
The angle subtended by the diameter
questions.solution: Central angle per standard chord length.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: A transition curve is used to
options: Provide a gradual change in radius between straight and circular curve
questions.solution: Gradual change in radius.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: The earthwork estimation for a road involves calculating
options: Only the top width of the road
Volumes of cut and fill along the alignment
questions.solution: Volumes of cut and fill.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: The determination of azimuth from coordinates uses
options: Inverse trigonometric functions of latitude and departure
questions.solution: Inverse trigonometric functions of lat/departure.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: Latitude of a line is its projection on the
questions.solution: Projection on north-south axis.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: Departure of a line is its projection on the
questions.solution: Projection on east-west axis.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: The area by coordinate method is given by
options: The sum of the side lengths
Half the absolute value of sum of cross products
questions.solution: Half the absolute value of cross products.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: For a closed traverse, the sum of latitudes should theoretically be
questions.solution: Zero.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: For a closed traverse, the sum of departures should theoretically be
questions.solution: Zero.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: The determination of latitude and longitude of a point uses
questions.solution: Astronomical observations or GPS.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: The volume of a cone is

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: The volume of a cylinder is
questions.solution: pi*r^2*h.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: The volume of earthwork in a borrow pit is calculated by
options: The product of the side lengths
Sum of corner depths multiplied by area of each block
questions.solution: Sum of corner depths times block area.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: The building estimation for masonry work is done in
options: Square meters for walls, cubic meters for foundations
questions.solution: Square meters for walls, cubic meters for foundations.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: The contour interval should be
options: Larger than the height range of the terrain
Smaller than the relief of the area permits
Equal to the height range of the survey area
Constant and suitable for the scale and terrain
questions.solution: Constant and suitable for scale and terrain.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: The characteristics of contours include
options: Contours do not cross, are close together for steep slopes
Spaced equally on all parts of the map
questions.solution: Do not cross, close together for steep slopes.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: The cross-sectional area at a chainage is measured to calculate
options: Volume of earthwork at that section
questions.solution: Volume of earthwork at that section.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: The prismoidal correction is applied to
options: Correct the trapezoidal formula for curvature of surface
questions.solution: Correct trapezoidal formula for surface curvature.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: In borehole surveying, the inclination of a borehole from the vertical is called:
questions.solution: Borehole deviation is the angular displacement of the borehole from the vertical axis.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: A borehole is drilled vertically but drifts to a bearing of N45°E with an inclination of 15° from vertical. The horizontal displacement at 300 m depth is approximately:
questions.solution: Horizontal displacement = depth × tan(inclination) = 300 × tan(15°) ≈ 300 × 0.2679 ≈ 80 m; closest is 78 m.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: The instrument commonly used for measuring borehole deviation at shallow depths is:
questions.solution: Multi-shot survey tools record deviation at multiple depths in a single run.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: Strike of a rock bed is defined as:
options: The line of intersection of the bed with a horizontal plane
The angle of dip of the bed
The direction perpendicular to the true dip
questions.solution: Strike is the line formed by the intersection of a bedding plane with a horizontal surface.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: DGMS (Tech.) (S&T) Circular No. 02 of 2010 deals with:
options: Design, control and monitoring of pit and dump slopes in opencast mines
questions.solution: DGMS (Tech.) (S&T) Circular No. 02 dated 06.07.2010 concerns design, control and monitoring of pit and dump slopes in opencast mines.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: Under CMR 2017, survey instruments at a mine shall be:
options: Calibrated once a year by the mine
Checked, maintained and calibrated at regular intervals as specified by the manufacturer
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 67(2): survey instruments are checked, maintained and calibrated at intervals specified by the manufacturer.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: A vertical fault with a horizontal displacement is classified as:
questions.solution: Strike-slip faults involve primarily horizontal movement parallel to the strike of the fault plane.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: Approaching a goaf, probing shall be carried out ahead of the working for at least:
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 147: the working is probed ahead for at least 1.5 m beyond the last support before approaching the goaf.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: Every mine plan or section under CMR 2017 shall show:
options: The magnetic meridian without any reference line
The true north, or the magnetic meridian with the date of the latter
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 64(1)(b): plans show true north or magnetic meridian and the date of the later.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: As per CMR 2017, every plan and section at a mine shall be:
options: Serially numbered and stored flat, with indexed field books kept at the mine
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 68: plans and sections are serially numbered, stored flat, and field books indexed and kept at the mine office.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: As per DGMS Circular 2/2010, strata and dump slope monitoring is mandatory for dumps exceeding ______ in height.
questions.solution: DGMS Circular 2/2010: monitoring (including slope stability radar / real-time monitoring) is made mandatory for dumps exceeding 60 m height.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: When workings extend to within 60 m of the settled boundary with an adjacent mine, the owner/agent/manager shall:
options: Inform the district magistrate and stop workings
Inform the adjacent mine and give its surveyors reasonable facilities for surveys
Stop all work in the mine
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 65(8): the adjacent mine is informed and its surveyors are given reasonable facilities for required surveys and levellings.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: Plans and sections required under CMR 2017 shall be corrected and maintained up-to-date at intervals not exceeding:
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 64(4): plans are kept corrected up-to-date not earlier than 3 months.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: The water-danger plan maintained under CMR 2017 shows water bodies existing within ______ of the boundary of the mine.
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 65(1)(g): a water-danger plan and section show water bodies existing up to 200 m of the mine boundary.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: Unless otherwise approved, mine plans and sections under CMR 2017 shall be prepared on a scale with a representative factor of:
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 64(1)(d): plans are on a scale with RF 2000:1 or 1000:1, with a scale bar at least 25 cm long.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: The joint survey plan showing workings near the common boundary with an adjacent mine shall be signed by:
options: The surveyors and managers of both the mine and the adjacent mine
The surveyor and the owner of the mine only
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 65(1)(e): the joint survey plan is signed by the surveyor and the manager of the mine and of adjoining mines whose workings come within 60 m of the common boundary.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: A borehole intersects a coal seam dipping at 20° in the direction N30°E. The borehole is vertical and the seam is 3 m thick. The length of borehole passing through the seam will be:
questions.solution: Length through seam = true thickness / cos(dip) = 3 / cos(20°) = 3 / 0.9397 ≈ 3.19 m.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: While driving approaching old or waterlogged workings, advance boreholes shall be kept at least ______ ahead of the face.
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 163: at least 3 advance boreholes not less than 3 m ahead of the face, with flank holes within 5 m on either side.

questions.stem: The cost price of 20 articles equals the selling price of 15 articles. What is the profit percentage?

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: A boat goes 20 km upstream in 5 hours and 20 km downstream in 2 hours. What is the speed of the current?
questions.solution: Upstream = 4 km/h, Downstream = 10 km/h. Speed of current = (10-4)/2 = 3 km/h

questions.stem: If A:B = 2:3 and B:C = 4:5, what is A:B:C?

questions.stem: Divide ₹1200 among A, B, C in the ratio 3:5:4.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: The SAARC summit is held every how many years?
questions.solution: SAARC summit is held every two years.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: Which country is India's largest trading partner?
questions.solution: USA has been India's largest trading partner in recent years.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: India shares the longest international border with which country?
questions.solution: India shares the longest border (4,096 km) with Bangladesh.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: The Quad (Quadrilateral Security Dialogue) includes which countries?
questions.solution: Quad includes India, USA, Japan, and Australia.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: BRICS New Development Bank headquarters is in which city?
questions.solution: NDB headquarters is in Shanghai, China.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: Which country became the newest member of BRICS in 2024?
questions.solution: Iran joined BRICS in January 2024.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: India's 'Act East Policy' was announced in which year?
questions.solution: Act East Policy was announced in 2014, replacing the Look East Policy of 1991.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: The International Solar Alliance (ISA) headquarters is located in which Indian city?
questions.solution: ISA headquarters is in Gurugram, Haryana.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: Which Indian city hosted the G20 Summit in 2023?
questions.solution: New Delhi hosted the G20 Summit in September 2023.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: India signed a free trade agreement with which bloc in 2022?
questions.solution: India-UAE CEPA (Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement) came into effect in May 2022.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: Which country is NOT a member of SAARC?
questions.solution: Myanmar is not a member of SAARC.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: The headquarters of the World Trade Organization (WTO) is in:
questions.solution: WTO headquarters is in Geneva, Switzerland.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: Which Indian state shares a border with Myanmar?
questions.solution: Manipur shares an international border with Myanmar.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: India's relationship with which country is described as 'All-Weather Friendship'?
questions.solution: India-Russia strategic partnership is often described as 'all-weather'.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: Which company is the largest coal producer in India?
questions.solution: Coal India Limited (CIL) is the largest coal producer in India.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: The headquarters of Coal India Limited is in which city?
questions.solution: CIL headquarters is in Kolkata, West Bengal.
